name: dockyard
description: Dockyard is a minimal, self-hosted tiled launcher dashboard for your favorite apps. Add tiles with a name, URL, and icon - or pick them from a dropdown list of running containers - show/hide them, and drag to rearrange. Optionally lock changes behind a password (with a forced change on first use). Everything is stored in a single apps.json file on a mounted volume.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for your app list, icons, background image, and password

paths.name: Docker Socket (optional)
paths.description: Optional: mount to enable 'Pick from Running Containers' in the Add App form. Security note: even mounted read-only, this gives Dockyard's process full control over Docker on this host - leave blank to skip.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port to reach the Dockyard web interface on

variables.name: Edit Password
variables.description: Optional: sets an initial password required before any changes can be made (you'll be forced to change it on first use). Leave blank for open editing.
